Mohela placed me on IBR after I had to file multiple complaints for them to get me off SAVE and on IBR. Mohela issued me a bill on XX/XX/XXXX of approximately {$770.00} due on XX/XX/XXXX pursuant to my IBR plan. I was happy about this as I have no more than three months of payments left before i qualify for public service loan forgiveness ( PSLF ). 

I went to make a payment on XXXX, which would have been payment XXXX for PSLF, only to learn Mohela improperly and illegally placed me on a forbearance against my will. This forbearance does not accrue time for PSLF, which prevents me from accessing my statutory guarantee of public service loan forgiveness despite continuing to work for the government. According to three agents I spoke with on recorded lines since XX/XX/XXXX, they all agree the forbearance was erroneously applied. Two agents confirmed my request for the forbearance to be removed was escalated to forbearance resolution, yet the forbearance remains on my account preventing my from making a PSLF qualifying payment.

According to notice from Mohela, I should only be on the forbearance if 1 ) I am on the SAVE repayment plan, or 2 ) It has been over 60 days since I submitted an IDR application and Mohela has been unable to act on it. Neither condition applies to me : 1 ) I am presently on IBR, not SAVE, and 2 ) I have no pending IDR application with Mohela or FSA. The only applications i ever submitted were to be placed on IBR, which was allowed in XX/XX/XXXX and generated an IBR bill on XX/XX/XXXX. 

Accordingly, the forbearance must be removed immediately so that I may make an XX/XX/XXXX payment and not further delay my access to PSLF. I am also requesting written documentation from Mohela as to the steps they have taken to remove the forbearance that three of their agents have confirmed were improperly applied to my account.

Consumer complaint narrative:
Good afternoon. I am writing to formally dispute the default status reported on my student loan, which has negatively affected my credit score. I understand the importance of staying current with financial obligations, and I would never intentionally default on a loan. However, in this case, I was never properly notified about the status of my student loan or the need to begin repayment. 

The communications and billing statements were sent to my former residencemy parents housewhich I have not lived at since graduating college. As a result, I was completely unaware that my account had entered default. I only became aware of the issue when I recently checked my credit report and saw the default had been reported. 

Had I received proper notification, I would have addressed the situation immediately. I am currently employed and fully capable of making payments. I am also eager to take steps toward resolving the matter responsibly. However, the default status is now significantly limiting my financial flexibility and damaging my credit standing, which further impairs my ability to resolve this issue efficiently. 

Given that the default occurred without proper notice or an opportunity to cure the delinquency, I respectfully request the removal or adjustment of the default from my credit report. I also ask that my account be considered for rehabilitation or other remedies that allow for correction without the long-term impact of a default that occurred under these unusual and unintended circumstances. 

Thank you for your time and understanding. I am committed to resolving this and welcome any assistance or options Mohela may offer. Please confirm receipt of this message and let me know what documentation or steps may be needed on my part to move forward.
